comparison.objective: Use a cue to strike a white ball so it sends a red ball into a goal without crossing a boundary.
comparison.physical_skill: Aimed impulse transfer through a cue and ball-to-ball collision.
comparison.success_condition: Red ball reaches the three-sided goal while arms and stick stay behind the line; hand striking, pushing, and reaching across are fouls.
comparison.reason: Both use controlled impact, but cue striking tests remote ballistic aiming through an intermediary ball, whereas the candidate tests stabilized coaxial tooling, notch fracture, component protection, and recovery of four released fragments.
